## Educational purpose

Everything on this site is published for research and education. Nothing here is a recommendation to buy or sell any security, and nothing is tailored to any reader's circumstances.

## Hypothetical results

Backtested results are hypothetical. They are produced by applying a set of rules to historical data and do not represent actual trading. They rely on assumptions described on the [methodology](methodology.qmd) page, and real results would differ. Past performance does not indicate future results.

## Not a Shariah ruling

Screening results on this site reflect the application of a published standard by the author. They are not a fatwa. Readers should consult a qualified scholar on questions of personal religious obligation.
